# Changelog

## 1.0.0, catalog update of 2026-11-17

The plugin's page tells you before you connect that an Atlassian organization admin must allow Flexkit's callback URL, with a link to Atlassian's guide. Atlassian's own consent screen only says the account isn't associated with a supported site. Same pin as before.

## 1.0.0

Pinned Atlassian's agent plugin at `352a02b05189e2a958a973867cc6eca365cb8fc3`, with the Atlassian MCP server's `/v2/mcp` endpoint and the five skills that need no other skill, bundled script or code workspace: `capture-tasks-from-meeting-notes`, `jira-sprint-dashboard`, `search-company-knowledge`, `spec-to-backlog` and `triage-issue`.
